description: Ahrefs Domain Rating (0–100) for domains or URLs, via getdr by Index Pages

fresh.description: Ignore the cache and fetch again.

targets.description: Domains or URLs. URLs are reduced to the host, www. is dropped, duplicates are removed; results follow the input order.

version.description: DR formula: dr3 or dr4 (the new one); default: the getdr server's or binary's config, dr3 unless set there. Values are not comparable between versions.

name: get_dr

checked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC; null for no response or an invalid target

dr.description: null: no data, or no response or an invalid target when checked_at is null

error.description: only on a target that is not a domain or URL

title: Ahrefs Domain Rating
